award_source.label: MICHELIN Guide Southwest 2026 — official press release (31 Aug 2026)

award_source_2.label: Visit Las Vegas (LVCVA) — MICHELIN Restaurants in Las Vegas

headline: Las Vegas IS covered by the MICHELIN Guide as of the inaugural 2026 MICHELIN Guide Southwest, revealed at Fontainebleau Las Vegas. The city holds 24 distinctions: 4 starred restaurants (5 stars total), 3 Bib Gourmand, 17 Recommended.
region_note: The 2026 Southwest selection covers 64 restaurants across Arizona, Nevada, New Mexico and Utah. The fifth starred restaurant, Monte, is in South Salt Lake, Utah — NOT in Las Vegas, and is excluded from the tables below.

status_definitions.label: MICHELIN Star
status_definitions.meaning: Currently holds one or two MICHELIN Stars in the 2026 selection. Highest distinction.

status_definitions.label: Bib Gourmand
status_definitions.meaning: Inspectors' award for good food at a moderate price. A distinct award — NOT a star.

status_definitions.label: MICHELIN Recommended / listed
status_definitions.meaning: Listed in the MICHELIN Guide as a recommended restaurant. NO star and NO Bib Gourmand.

price_rule: A dollar figure appears only where the restaurant's own official site publishes a price. 'For 2 adults' is that published per-person price x 2, before tax, tip, drinks and add-ons. Where only a symbol ($$ / $$$$) is published, the symbol is shown and the dollar amount is left blank.

price_2.note: Official menu: 5 courses $130 pp ($260 for 2, ~1.5 h); 7 courses $160 pp ($320 for 2, ~2.5 h); Signature 9 courses $210 pp ($420 for 2, ~3 h). Before tax/tip. Wine pairing per person: 5-glass $60, 7-glass $84, 9-glass $108 (premium add $40/$56/$72); 5-glass Champagne $125. Seared foie gras add-on +$33 pp.

contact.v: Reservations via OpenTable on the official site

rows.note: Menu changes monthly. CANNOT accommodate vegan, dairy-free, celiac, or garlic/onion-free diets. Automatic 20% gratuity only for parties of 6+ (does not apply to 2).

clusters.name: Strip — MGM Grand

clusters.name: Strip — The Venetian / Palazzo
clusters.detail: Bouchon, COTE, Estiatorio Milos, Mott 32 — all Recommended. Highest COUNT of distinctions at one resort.

clusters.detail: Kabuto, Kame Omakase, Lamaii, Partage, Pho Ga Bac Bac, Sparrow + Wolf. Densest walkable cluster in the city; one short bus or rideshare hop from the Strip.
